build.beforeBuildCommand: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const repoRoot = process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE || process.cwd(); const projectRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'src-tauri'); const required = [path.join(projectRoot, 'wintun.dll'), path.join(repoRoot, 'native/chain/build/windows/amd64/auroravpn-core.exe'), path.join(repoRoot, 'native/tor/build/windows/amd64/lyrebird.exe'), path.join(repoRoot, 'native/tor/build/windows/amd64/snowflake.exe')]; const missing = required.filter((f) => !fs.existsSync(f)); if (missing.length) { console.error('Missing Tauri build artifacts:\n' + missing.join('\n')); process.exit(1); }"
